pathway.title: Registered Nurse in Australia: Ahpra/NMBA registration and skilled migration
pathway.regulator: Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia (NMBA), with applications handled by Ahpra (Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency)
pathway.summary: Since 23 April 2025, experienced RNs registered and working in an NMBA-approved comparable jurisdiction (UK, Ireland, US, Canada's British Columbia and Ontario, Singapore, Spain) can apply straight to Ahpra under the IQRN standard, with no NMBA exams or upgrade (about 1–6 months). Other internationally qualified nurses do the free Self-check and are placed in Stream A (Orientation, then apply), Stream B (Outcomes-Based Assessment: NCLEX-RN, then OSCE in Australia) or Stream C (upgrade qualification first). After registration, nurses usually get an ANMAC skills assessment and apply for a skilled visa (189, 190, 491) or an employer-sponsored visa (482 Skills in Demand, 186).

phases.title: Choose your route
phases.sub: IQRN fast track, Self-check streams, or Trans-Tasman (NZ)
steps: Check the IQRN standard (in effect 23 April 2025): you need at least 1,800 hours as an RN in an approved comparable jurisdiction since 1 January 2017.
Pathway 1: your nursing qualification and RN registration are from a comparable jurisdiction (UK, Ireland, US, British Columbia or Ontario in Canada, Singapore, Spain).

Pathway 2: you trained elsewhere but passed that jurisdiction's regulatory exam (for example NCLEX-RN for a US license) and hold or held RN registration there since 1 January 2017, plus the 1,800 hours there.
If you are not eligible for IQRN, complete the free Ahpra/NMBA Self-check. It places you in Stream A, B or C (or asks Ahpra to assess an unlisted qualification).
If you are registered in New Zealand, use Trans-Tasman Mutual Recognition instead (a separate process).
Note: a US license held while working outside a comparable jurisdiction does not count; the 1,800 hours must be worked in a comparable jurisdiction.

phases.title: English language and documents
phases.sub: Meet the English language skills registration standard
steps: For tests taken on or after 23 April 2026: IELTS Academic overall 7 (listening 7, reading 7, writing 6.5, speaking 7).
OET: listening 350, reading 360, writing 350, speaking 360 (no overall score; letter grades no longer used for new tests).
PTE Academic: overall 63 (listening 58, reading 59, writing 60, speaking 76). TOEFL iBT: overall 91 (listening 22, reading 22, writing 23, speaking 24).
You may combine two sittings of the same test taken no more than 12 months apart, if each meets the overall score and the minimum floors.
Results are generally valid for 2 years before you apply. Tests taken on or before 22 April 2026 are judged against the older score table.
Collect identity, qualification, registration history and employer statements of practice hours.
links: NMBA – English language skills registration standard

phases.title: IQNM assessment fee, Orientation Part 1, Portfolio
phases.sub: For Self-check route (Streams A and B)
phases.cost: IQNM assessment fee AUD 410 (fee schedule effective 20 Sep 2023; check current schedule)
steps: Pay the non-refundable IQNM assessment fee in your Ahpra IQNM dashboard. It covers Orientation Part 1 and Ahpra's document review.
Complete Orientation Part 1: an online course about Australia and its healthcare system.
Stream A: after Orientation Part 1 you can apply for registration (documents are reviewed at registration).
Stream B: submit your Portfolio (identity and qualification documents) for review before the exams.
Stream C: you must first complete an approved upgrade (for example a bachelor of nursing) before you can continue.

phases.title: Outcomes-Based Assessment (Stream B)
phases.time: Several months (whole OBA route often 9–12+ months)
phases.cost: NCLEX-RN USD 200 + USD 150 international scheduling fee (NCLEX registration rises to USD 350 from 1 Feb 2027); OSCE AUD 4,000 per sitting
steps: After Portfolio approval, register and pay for NCLEX-RN with Pearson VUE through NCSBN; book at a Pearson VUE center after you get your Authorisation to Test.
If you already passed NCLEX-RN, send your candidate report (authorising jurisdiction, test date, result) so Ahpra can consider it.
After passing NCLEX-RN, pay the OSCE fee in your IQNM dashboard.
Travel to Australia for the OSCE at Adelaide Health Simulation (Adelaide, SA) or RANZCOG (Melbourne, VIC). Sittings run each month.
Contact only the IQNM exams team about the OSCE, not the test centers.
links: NMBA – Examination information for registered nurses

phases.title: Apply for general registration
phases.time: IQRN route about 1–6 months; Ahpra often 4–10 weeks once complete
phases.cost: Application AUD 318 (2023 schedule) + registration AUD 193 (2025/26 fee)
steps: Apply online to Ahpra for general registration as a registered nurse (IQRN Pathway 1/2, Stream A, or after passing OBA).
Provide proof of identity, English, registration history, practice hours and criminal history checks.
Meet all NMBA core standards: English, criminal history, professional indemnity insurance, recency of practice, continuing professional development.
Answer any Ahpra requests quickly; incomplete applications take longer.
Do not resign or move before registration is confirmed and you have a firm job offer.
links: NMBA – Fees for nurses and midwives

phases.title: ANMAC skills assessment and visa
phases.time: varies (ANMAC does not publish a fixed time; visas take months)
phases.cost: ANMAC Modified AUD 395 / Full AUD 595; visa fees vary
steps: If you hold Ahpra registration, apply to ANMAC for a skills assessment (Modified assessment, AUD 395). A Full assessment (AUD 595) exists for some unregistered overseas nurses.
For points-tested visas (189, 190, 491), lodge an Expression of Interest in SkillSelect with your ANZSCO code; the pass mark is 65 points.
For state nomination (190 or 491), check each state's current list and open rounds; many states open and close during the July–June program year.
For employer sponsorship, find an employer who will nominate you for the Skills in Demand visa (subclass 482, replaced the TSS visa in December 2024) or Employer Nomination Scheme (186).
Meet health and character checks; keep registration and skills assessment current while you wait.
links: Smart Move Australia – Skills in Demand visa

points.summary: You need at least 65 points (age, English, work experience, qualifications, partner, Australian study and more) to lodge an Expression of Interest in SkillSelect. For the 189 visa, Home Affairs invites the highest-ranked EOIs per occupation in periodic rounds; ties are broken by date of effect. State nomination adds 5 points (190) or 15 points (491) and follows each state's own rules.

sid.summary: The Skills in Demand visa (subclass 482) replaced the Temporary Skill Shortage visa in December 2024. It has three streams: Core Skills (occupation on the Core Skills Occupation List and salary at or above the Core Skills Income Threshold), Specialist Skills (higher salary threshold), and Labour Agreement. Stay is up to 4 years, with no age limit, and it can lead to permanent residence through the Employer Nomination Scheme (186). The Core Skills Income Threshold was reported as AUD 79,499 for applications lodged from 1 July 2026. Many public health services (for example SA Health) sponsor nurses for roles they cannot fill locally.

notes: ANMAC skills assessment is separate from Ahpra registration; a positive ANMAC result does not mean you can register to practice.
Home Affairs still uses ANZSCO codes for migration as of mid-2026; a move to the new OSCA classification is expected but not yet adopted.
State nomination programs reset each July and allocations are often used up before June; check official state pages often.
Employers such as WA Health sponsor only experienced nurses in areas of critical shortage, and will not sponsor visas for bridging courses or English testing.

bedside.title: Practicing in Australia
points: All RNs must follow the NMBA Code of conduct for nurses and the Registered nurse standards for practice. Breaches can be reported to Ahpra.
When a patient is harmed, you take part in open, honest and timely discussion with the patient and family under the Australian Open Disclosure Framework (revised version now published).
Clinical handover usually uses ISBAR (Identify, Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation) or ISOBAR, under the national Communicating for Safety standard.
Medicare funds public hospital care for eligible people. Most nurses work in state-run public hospitals, with a large private hospital sector alongside.
ENs are registered by the NMBA and work under the direction and supervision of an RN. As an RN you delegate to and supervise ENs and assistants in nursing.
Health information is protected under the Privacy Act and the Australian Privacy Principles, plus state health records laws. Only access records you need for care.
Registration is renewed every year by 31 May, and you must declare recency of practice, CPD and professional indemnity insurance.

SkillSelect round dates are from third-party summaries; the official Home Affairs rounds page (last updated 19 Aug 2026) did not render its tables, so invitation counts and RN point cut-offs were removed. A round around August 2026 may be missing from this list.

State 190/491 statuses for VIC, QLD, WA, SA, ACT and NT come from a third-party tracker (Sep–Oct 2026). Only NSW (RNs on lists) and TAS (opened 17 Aug 2026) were confirmed on official pages. Nurse eligibility for each state's 2026-27 list is not confirmed.

Skills in Demand Core Skills Income Threshold of AUD 79,499 from 1 July 2026 is from a third-party alert; Home Affairs pages could not be fetched. Work experience requirement and whether every RN code is on the Core Skills Occupation List were not verified.

ANMAC fees are confirmed on its fees page (no effective date or GST shown); processing time is not published; ANMAC has signalled a new portal, renamed assessments and revised fees later in 2026. ANMAC site blocked direct reading of eligibility rules.
Possible move from ANZSCO to OSCA codes for migration has not happened as of mid-2026 but may happen soon.
